doc: AIKI-HLA v1.0 — minimum MHC G-domain sequence database bundled with the package. Covers every allele in the released corpus (n=285).  Source: data/csv/platform_sequences.csv distilled from IPD-IMGT/HLA, IPD-MHC, UniProt, NCBI.  Extended database (37,480 entries across multiple species) ships separately on Zenodo for users querying alleles outside this set.
